_comment: Operator corrections to inferred source coverage. Authority beats inference: anything set here overrides source_coverage.py's evidence-based guess. Fill onset_week/mature_week from actual scraper deployment dates where known. Week format is W-SUN period string, e.g. 2026-04-06/2026-04-12.

_schema.onset_week: period string | null  - first week scraper was live
_schema.mature_week: period string | null - first week at full production volume
_schema.note: free text, replaces the generated note
